title: Did Columbus know he had found a new continent?

post.caption: The History of Spain, episode 9: Columbus, the 1492 voyage from Palos to San Salvador, the Treaty of Tordesillas and the man who died thinking he had reached Asia. Images: public domain. Map data: Natural Earth.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Did Columbus know he had found a new continent?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Never. He died convinced he had reached Asia.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Why did no one believe in his plan?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: For years, everyone said no. Portugal turned him down. Spain's experts said his numbers were wrong.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: And they were right: he thought the Earth was much smaller than it is.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: So who said yes?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Once Granada had fallen, Queen Isabella did. Columbus demanded the title of admiral, a governorship, and a tenth of the profits. He got them.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: On the third of August 1492, he sailed west from Palos with three ships and about ninety men.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Were they scared?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Weeks of open ocean. The crew came close to mutiny.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Then, on the twelfth of October, a lookout shouted: land! An island in the Bahamas. Columbus named it San Salvador.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: He called the people he met Indians, because he was sure he was in the Indies.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Who owned the new lands?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: In 1494, at Tordesillas, Spain and Portugal drew a line down the Atlantic: west for Spain, east for Portugal. That's why Brazil speaks Portuguese.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: And Columbus?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: He sailed there four times. He died in 1506, still insisting it was Asia.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: A year later, a German mapmaker named the new land after another explorer, Amerigo Vespucci. America.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Next time: the boy who inherited half the world. Like the video and follow History Sketches.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: And tell us in the comments what you think!
